component.name: LiveTVGuide
component.script:
sub init() m.rows = m.top.findNode("rows") m.timeLabelsGroup = m.top.findNode("timeLabelsGroup") m.nowPlayingTimer = m.top.findNode("nowPlayingTimer") m.detailPoster = m.top.findNode("detailPoster") m.offAirStatic = m.top.findNode("offAirStatic") m.detailTitle = m.top.findNode("detailTitle") m.detailTime = m.top.findNode("detailTime") m.detailDescription = m.top.findNode("detailDescription") m.focusFrame = m.top.findNode("focusFrame")
m.top.observeField("content", "onContentChanged") m.top.observeField("focusRequested", "onFocusRequested") m.top.observeField("visible", "onVisibilityChanged") m.top.observeField("focused", "onVisibilityChanged") m.nowPlayingTimer.observeField("fire", "onNowPlayingTimer")
' Screen Constants m.ROW_HEIGHT = 150 m.CHANNEL_WIDTH = 533 m.SLOT_WIDTH = 320 m.VISIBLE_ROWS = 4 ' The 1387px program viewport holds four complete 320px slots. m.VISIBLE_COLS = 4 m.TOTAL_SLOTS = 48 m.WINDOW_CHANNELS = 6 m.DETAIL_VIEWPORT_HEIGHT = 220 m.DETAIL_SCROLL_STEP = 4
' Data Index Cursors m.channelIndex = 0 m.selectedSlotIndex = 0 m.topRowIndex = 0 m.leftColIndex = 0 m.detailDescriptionScrollOffset = 0 m.hasDetailPoster = false m.windowChannelStart = 0 m.totalChannels = 0
m.rowPool = [] m.headerLabelPool = [] m.programIndex = {}
buildComponentPool() end sub
sub buildComponentPool() for c = 0 to m.VISIBLE_COLS - 1 lbl = createObject("roSGNode", "Label") lbl.width = m.SLOT_WIDTH - 20 lbl.height = 30 lbl.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" lbl.color = "#9DB0C3" m.timeLabelsGroup.appendChild(lbl)
line = createObject("roSGNode", "Rectangle") line.width = 1 line.height = 50 line.color = "#2A3A4E" m.timeLabelsGroup.appendChild(line)
m.headerLabelPool.push({ label: lbl, line: line }) end for
for r = 0 to m.VISIBLE_ROWS - 1 rowGroup = createObject("roSGNode", "Group")
card = rowGroup.createChild("Group") card.clippingRect = [0, 0, m.CHANNEL_WIDTH - 2, m.ROW_HEIGHT - 4] bg = card.createChild("Rectangle") bg.width = m.CHANNEL_WIDTH - 2 bg.height = m.ROW_HEIGHT - 4 bg.color = "#182331"
title = card.createChild("Label") title.translation = [18, 30] title.width = m.CHANNEL_WIDTH - 36 title.height = 40 title.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" title.color = "#FFFFFF"
progGroup = rowGroup.createChild("Group") progGroup.translation = [m.CHANNEL_WIDTH, 0]
slots = [] for c = 0 to m.VISIBLE_COLS - 1 tile = progGroup.createChild("Group") tileBg = tile.createChild("Rectangle") tileBg.width = m.SLOT_WIDTH - 2 tileBg.height = m.ROW_HEIGHT - 4 tileBg.color = "#202E3D"
lbl = tile.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [10, 15] lbl.width = m.SLOT_WIDTH - 20 lbl.height = 30 lbl.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" lbl.color = "#FFFFFF"
timeLbl = tile.createChild("Label") timeLbl.translation = [10, 50] timeLbl.width = m.SLOT_WIDTH - 20 timeLbl.height = 25 timeLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" timeLbl.color = "#7E92A7"
slots.push({ tile: tile, bg: tileBg, label: lbl, timeLabel: timeLbl }) end for
m.rows.appendChild(rowGroup) m.rowPool.push({ rowGroup: rowGroup, titleLabel: title, progGroup: progGroup, slots: slots }) end for end sub
sub onVisibilityChanged() if m.top.visible and m.top.hasFocus() m.nowPlayingTimer.control = "start" else m.nowPlayingTimer.control = "stop" end if updateFallbackPosterVisibility() end sub
sub onFocusRequested() if m.top.focusRequested m.top.setFocus(true) renderView() end if end sub
sub onContentChanged() if m.top.content = invalid then return isReset = m.top.content.reset = true m.windowChannelStart = m.top.content.windowChannelStart m.totalChannels = m.top.content.totalChannels m.windowStartSeconds = m.top.content.windowStartSeconds buildFastProgramIndex() if isReset m.channelIndex = 0 m.selectedSlotIndex = 0 m.topRowIndex = 0 m.leftColIndex = 0 end if renderView() end sub
sub calculateWindowStartTime() dt = createObject("roDateTime") dt.mark() utcSecs = dt.asSeconds() dt.toLocalTime() secondsIntoBlock = (dt.getMinutes() * 60 + dt.getSeconds()) mod 1800 m.windowStartSeconds = utcSecs - secondsIntoBlock end sub
sub buildFastProgramIndex() m.programIndex = {} if m.top.content = invalid then return
for cIdx = 0 to m.top.content.getChildCount() - 1 chNode = m.top.content.getChild(cIdx) if chNode <> invalid for pIdx = 0 to chNode.getChildCount() - 1 prog = chNode.getChild(pIdx) if prog <> invalid and prog.startTimeSeconds <> invalid and prog.startTimeSeconds >= 0 st = prog.startTimeSeconds dur = prog.durationSeconds if dur <= 0 then dur = 1800
' Only map block instants at or after the program starts. blockStart = st - (st mod 1800) if blockStart < st then blockStart += 1800 blockEnd = st + dur
currBlock = blockStart while currBlock < blockEnd key = cIdx.toStr() + "_" + currBlock.toStr() if not m.programIndex.doesExist(key) m.programIndex[key] = prog end if currBlock += 1800 end while end if end for end if end for end sub
sub renderView() if m.top.content = invalid then return if m.totalChannels <= 0 then return
if m.channelIndex < m.topRowIndex m.topRowIndex = m.channelIndex else if m.channelIndex >= m.topRowIndex + m.VISIBLE_ROWS m.topRowIndex = m.channelIndex - m.VISIBLE_ROWS + 1 end if
if m.selectedSlotIndex < m.leftColIndex m.leftColIndex = m.selectedSlotIndex else if m.selectedSlotIndex >= m.leftColIndex + m.VISIBLE_COLS m.leftColIndex = m.selectedSlotIndex - m.VISIBLE_COLS + 1 end if
' Headers for c = 0 to m.VISIBLE_COLS - 1 colIdx = m.leftColIndex + c lblRec = m.headerLabelPool[c] xPos = c * m.SLOT_WIDTH lblRec.label.translation = [xPos + 10, 10] lblRec.label.text = formatSlotTime(m.windowStartSeconds + (colIdx * 1800)) lblRec.line.translation = [xPos, 0] end for
' Rows for r = 0 to m.VISIBLE_ROWS - 1 chIdx = m.topRowIndex + r rowRec = m.rowPool[r]
channel = channelForIndex(chIdx) if channel <> invalid rowRec.rowGroup.visible = true rowRec.rowGroup.translation = [0, r * m.ROW_HEIGHT] if channel.title <> invalid rowRec.titleLabel.text = channel.title end if
for c = 0 to m.VISIBLE_COLS - 1 colIdx = m.leftColIndex + c slotRec = rowRec.slots[c] slotRec.tile.translation = [c * m.SLOT_WIDTH, 0]
targetTime = m.windowStartSeconds + (colIdx * 1800) prog = findProgramAtTime(chIdx, targetTime)
if prog <> invalid slotRec.label.text = prog.title slotRec.timeLabel.text = prog.startTimeText slotRec.bg.color = "#202E3D" slotRec.label.color = "#FFFFFF" else slotRec.label.text = "Off Air" slotRec.timeLabel.text = formatSlotTime(targetTime) slotRec.bg.color = "#121A24" slotRec.label.color = "#5C6F84" end if end for else rowRec.rowGroup.visible = false end if end for
' Position Focus Highlight Frame relRow = m.channelIndex - m.topRowIndex relCol = m.selectedSlotIndex - m.leftColIndex m.focusFrame.translation = [m.CHANNEL_WIDTH + (relCol * m.SLOT_WIDTH), relRow * m.ROW_HEIGHT]
updateDetails() end sub
function findProgramAtTime(channelIdx as integer, targetTime as integer) as object localIndex = channelIdx - m.windowChannelStart if localIndex < 0 then return invalid key = localIndex.toStr() + "_" + targetTime.toStr() if m.programIndex.doesExist(key) prog = m.programIndex[key] if prog <> invalid and prog.startTimeSeconds <> invalid and prog.durationSeconds <> invalid duration = prog.durationSeconds if duration <= 0 then duration = 1800 if targetTime >= prog.startTimeSeconds and targetTime < prog.startTimeSeconds + duration return prog end if end if end if return invalid end function
function channelForIndex(channelIdx as integer) as object if m.top.content = invalid then return invalid localIndex = channelIdx - m.windowChannelStart if localIndex < 0 or localIndex >= m.top.content.getChildCount() then return invalid return m.top.content.getChild(localIndex) end function
sub updateDetails() if m.top.content = invalid then return chNode = channelForIndex(m.channelIndex) if chNode = invalid then return
targetTime = m.windowStartSeconds + (m.selectedSlotIndex * 1800) prog = findProgramAtTime(m.channelIndex, targetTime)
if prog <> invalid m.detailTitle.text = prog.title m.detailTime.text = prog.startTimeText + " (" + formatDuration(prog.durationSeconds) + ")" m.detailDescription.text = prog.description if prog.HDPosterUrl <> invalid and prog.HDPosterUrl <> "" m.detailPoster.uri = prog.HDPosterUrl m.detailPoster.visible = true m.hasDetailPoster = true else m.detailPoster.uri = "" m.detailPoster.visible = false m.hasDetailPoster = false end if updateFallbackPosterVisibility() else m.detailTitle.text = "Off Air" m.detailTime.text = formatSlotTime(targetTime) m.detailDescription.text = "This channel is currently off air." m.detailPoster.uri = "" m.detailPoster.visible = false m.hasDetailPoster = false updateFallbackPosterVisibility() end if
m.detailDescriptionScrollOffset = 0 m.detailDescription.translation = [0, 0] end sub
sub updateFallbackPosterVisibility() m.offAirStatic.visible = not m.hasDetailPoster and m.top.visible end sub
sub onNowPlayingTimer() previousWindowStart = m.windowStartSeconds calculateWindowStartTime() if m.windowStartSeconds <> previousWindowStart requestWindow(m.channelIndex, false) else renderView() end if end sub
sub requestWindow(channelIndex as integer, reset as boolean) channelStart = channelIndex - (m.VISIBLE_ROWS - 1) if channelStart < 0 then channelStart = 0 m.top.windowRequested = { channelStart: channelStart, channelCount: m.WINDOW_CHANNELS, windowStartSeconds: m.windowStartSeconds, slotCount: m.TOTAL_SLOTS, reset: reset } end sub
function scrollDetailDescription(direction as integer) as boolean contentBounds = m.detailDescription.boundingRect() maxScroll = contentBounds.height - m.DETAIL_VIEWPORT_HEIGHT if maxScroll <= 0 then return false
newOffset = m.detailDescriptionScrollOffset + (direction * m.DETAIL_SCROLL_STEP) if newOffset < 0 then newOffset = 0 if newOffset > maxScroll then newOffset = maxScroll
if newOffset <> m.detailDescriptionScrollOffset m.detailDescriptionScrollOffset = newOffset m.detailDescription.translation = [0, -newOffset] return true end if return false end function
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press or m.top.content = invalid then return false
if key = "fastforward" m.top.fastForwardPressed = true scrollDetailDescription(1) return true else if key = "rewind" m.top.fastRewindPressed = true scrollDetailDescription(-1) return true else if key = "up" if m.channelIndex > 0 m.channelIndex-- if channelForIndex(m.channelIndex) = invalid requestWindow(m.channelIndex, false) else renderView() end if end if return true else if key = "down" if m.channelIndex + 1 < m.totalChannels m.channelIndex++ if channelForIndex(m.channelIndex) = invalid requestWindow(m.channelIndex, false) else renderView() end if end if return true else if key = "right" if m.selectedSlotIndex + 1 < m.TOTAL_SLOTS m.selectedSlotIndex++ renderView() end if return true else if key = "left" if m.selectedSlotIndex > 0 m.selectedSlotIndex-- renderView() else m.top.menuRequested = true end if return true else if key = "OK" m.top.channelSelected = m.channelIndex return true end if return false end function
function formatSlotTime(seconds as integer) as string dateObj = createObject("roDateTime") dateObj.fromSeconds(seconds) dateObj.toLocalTime() hours = dateObj.getHours() mins = dateObj.getMinutes() suffix = "a" if hours >= 12 suffix = "p" if hours > 12 then hours -= 12 else if hours = 0 hours = 12 end if minStr = mins.toStr() if mins < 10 then minStr = "0" + minStr return hours.toStr() + ":" + minStr + suffix end function
function formatDuration(seconds as integer) as string mins = int(seconds / 60) hrs = int(mins / 60) remMins = mins mod 60 if hrs = 0 then return mins.toStr() + "m" if remMins = 0 then return hrs.toStr() + "h" return hrs.toStr() + "h " + remMins.toStr() + "m" end function
